title: MFVN Boulsa meeting supporting transition and requesting government attention to provincial development/security
scope: One local meeting; source describes the public action as held on Saturday 1 April, and the report was published Sunday 2 April.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown; opened body reports no participant number or qualitative crowd size.

start_date.summary: InfoBF item dated 2 April says the meeting was held Saturday, which is 1 April 2023.

location.summary: The report places the meeting in Boulsa, Namentenga Province, Centre-Nord Region.

organizer.summary: The report names the Mouvement force vive du Namentenga (MFVN).

demands.summary: Although framed as support for the transition, the report says the movement also invited the government to address provincial development and the security apparatus. The stated request is directed to the domestic government; whether it was a substantive grievance or a supportive appeal is retained for review.

participants_original.summary: Unknown; no attendance estimate in the accessible body.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Unknown; no simultaneous crowd threshold evidence.

state_response.summary: Unknown; no response by government to the meeting is reported.

notes: InfoBF republishes/credits AIB; do not count the AIB and InfoBF pages as independent. Support framing is not a categorical exclusion, but crowd threshold is not established. The article also reports contributions to IDPs, VDP and war effort; those contributions are not attendee evidence.
open_questions: Was at least 50 people present simultaneously?
Did the concrete government request materially motivate the gathering, beyond expressions of support?
